start: Member finishes a 'Push 1' workout, heavier than the previous Push 1 on 15 Oct

steps.action: Tap Finish and land on the workout-complete screen
user_sees: Card with 'Kg lifted', the big number '1,925 kg', and in green '+45 kg more than previous'
Line 'Previous: 1,880 kg in Push 1 on 15 Oct' with a chevron
must_not: Warm-up sets counted in the kg
Red text for any number

steps.action: Tap 'See each exercise (5)'
user_sees: The card opens: each exercise with its tag, green when up, grey when down, 'Not done this time' or 'Not in that workout' where it fits; the link reads 'Hide exercises'
must_not: The words 'volume', 'PR' or 'session'
An exercise listed twice

start: Workout-complete screen with a previous workout to compare

steps.action: Tap the line 'Previous: 1,880 kg in Push 1 on 15 Oct'
user_sees: That earlier workout opens, to see what was done then
must_not: Another workout opened than the one named

steps.action: Finish a workout with only body-weight moves (push-ups, pull-ups)
user_sees: Label 'Reps done', big '120 reps', compared with the previous body-weight workout
must_not: A '0 kg' headline
Reps compared with a weighted workout

steps.action: Where only the comparison line shows, tap 'See that workout'
user_sees: The compared workout opens
must_not: A dead link

steps.action: Finish the very first workout of a routine
user_sees: The total and 'Your number to beat next time.'; no 'Previous' line
must_not: A made-up previous number
'+1,925 kg more than previous'

steps.action: Finish only 2 sets where last time had 20
user_sees: 'A shorter workout than the previous one. Every workout counts.' and no 'Previous' line
must_not: 'Lighter than previous' against a full workout

steps.action: Finish a run with no weight and no reps
user_sees: No kg card at all
must_not: A card showing '0 reps' or '0 kg'

start: Workout-complete screen, the same routine done before

steps.action: Finish lighter than the previous time
user_sees: Grey 'Lighter than previous. Every workout counts.'; card border plain, not green
must_not: Red text or a warning mark

steps.action: Finish lighter in an easy week
user_sees: 'Easy week: lighter on purpose.'
must_not: The plain 'Lighter' line in an easy week

steps.action: Finish within 1 kg of the previous time
user_sees: 'Same as previous'
must_not: '+0 kg more than previous'

steps.action: Open the exercise list, then tap 'Hide exercises'
user_sees: The list closes; the chevron turns back
must_not: The list reopening by itself

start: Workout-complete screen after beating the previous time, member opens Share

steps.action: Look at the share picture
user_sees: Only the brag '+45 kg more than previous' from the card is used, and only when today beat the previous time
must_not: The brag on a picture when today was lighter
Numbers on the picture that let someone work out the member's body weight

steps.action: Close Share
user_sees: The card is shown only on the member's own phone
must_not: The kg comparison sent to the gym or anyone else by this card
